svg.text: COMPARATIVE ARCHITECTURES FOR TOMATO LEAF DISEASE DETECTION
The only model here with no feature-pyramid neck.
Trained through the Ultralytics pipeline, which adds mosaic, copy-paste and mixup augmentation the other three do not.
Shares its head, anchors and loss with RetinaNeXt, so the comparison isolates backbone, neck and attention.
P6 and P7 are added after the BiFPN by strided convolution, not fused inside it.
